_meta.description: Single source of truth for brand identity. Name, tagline and colours live here. The cow mark's geometry lives in scripts/build-brand-svgs.mjs; `npm run brand:build` writes every SVG variant to /public and `npm run brand:png` renders the PNG/ICO icons and the social card.

name: CultureFlow
shortTag: Events for every culture and community
description: Discover and host events for every culture and community — festivals, weddings, worship, music, food and gatherings near you and around the world. Tickets, discovery and connection in one place.
_markNote: Mark = a long-horned cow, an ancient symbol of gathering and shared wealth: open lyre horns in blue, black head, a gold sun cradled between the horn tips. Name = CULTURE / FLOW in wide Archivo Black caps; FLOW takes the horn colour. Flat colour, sharp edges, no gradients. See docs/brand.md.
